alt: Bar chart of trips for each hour of the day. Midnight has about 21,700 trips, more than twice any other hour. Other hours are mostly between 9,000 and 10,000. Rush hours, 7–9 and 17–19, are highlighted.
caption: Trips by hour of day, with rush hours (7–9 and 17–19) highlighted. About 21,700 trips are logged at midnight, more than twice the busiest other hour, which suggests missing times were filled in as midnight.
